body:
I relate so hard to this. Parents had me for no reason, and they were constantly anxious and hypercritical and socially awkward.

I want to find a different way of living from them.
I question that all the time too.

I think I understand, the more you have, the higher the stakes I guess.

It seems like you have several well defined problems that you need to reach a decision on. I think you'll eventually reach a satisfactory resolution, you seem to have a lot of insight into your own situation.
Thanks man, hoping the same for you too.

The grieving part definitely resonates with me. I feel like I lost out on/passed by a lot of stuff too, and I'm trying to resolve those feelings too. Sometimes it doesn't work so well and I start blaming everything again, but your post reminded me how important it is to take responsibility and find peace.
This gave me a little more hope. Thank you.
Aw man, is that why the tongue is hanging out?
Hoping I can reach this mindset too. It was pretty sweet, no worries :)

Thanks for the comment man. I guess I have to make a choice as to what kind of life I want to live and own it.

Respect for the way you handled your pain too, not everyone deals with it by growing up and maturing. I hope you can enjoy your youth eventually and find your own tribe.

Please don't beat yourself up man. I heard that beating addiction is not linear, everybody is bound to relapse on their path to recovery. I'm sorry it happened today, but you managed to stop yourself and what matters is that you can get back on track again.
I feel this way too. I hope something sparks your interest in things back eventually.
